exposure: umbilical cord serum vitamin D levels
cohort: The study included 34 infants with transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN) and 82 neonates in a control group without respiratory distress, along with their mothers.
finding: Infants with TTN and their mothers had significantly lower serum vitamin D levels compared to the control group (P<0.001 for both neonatal and maternal levels).
